title: Christopher N NDE 5174
content: This happened to me at the time of my accident, and the experience consisted of three different parts. First, I floated above myself on the operating table and I could see the doctors and nurses working on me. It was a short-lived experience but very vivid. Secondly, I found myself floating in a dark room, with bright white clouds all in the background, with light coming from behind the white clouds. My family members were. There was also a team of doctors standing in a perfect circle around me. I believe it was here where I decided, or was told, to come back - it was not my time. Thirdly, in this one I have proof I was out of my body. I was in a coma for ten days, and my sister was in the room holding my hand. I was across the room by the door, looking at her. I would see the back of her head, and then she would turn towards the door and begin to cry. I could see her perfectly. When I came out of my coma, one of the first things I asked her, was 'Why were you crying?' and she stated she wasn't. Then I told her that I had seen her from across the room. When I told her that, the hair stood up on the back of her neck, she told me later. Then she admitted that she had wanted to be strong for me, so she would turn away from me in the bed in order to try to keep me from seeing her weakness. I explained that I had been over by the doorway, out of my body, and that when she had turned to cry, she was actually facing right toward me. This last one is proof, in my opinion. How else would I have seen her crying? Since then, I have read a book about OBEs and I practice inducing them. I have been able to get out of my body on my own.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Across the room by the door/doorway, looking at his sister holding his hand.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'team of doctors' standing in a perfect circle around him (unclear if earthly or non-physical).

environment.environment_other_detail: A dark room with bright white clouds in the background, with light coming from behind the clouds.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He describes three parts: (1) OBE above body on operating table; (2) dark room with clouds/light, family members present, doctors in a circle, 'not my time'; (3) veridical OBE during coma viewing sister crying from doorway.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurs first; no tunnel reported; later a dark-room/cloud scene; later another OBE during coma.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Out-of-body perception occurred in multiple parts (operating table and later during coma).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He reports a 'team of doctors standing in a perfect circle' around him in the dark-room/cloud scene. He also reports later learning about OBEs and practicing inducing them, successfully.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I floated above myself on the operating table and I could see the doctors and nurses working on me.” “I found myself floating in a dark room, with bright white clouds all in the background, with light coming from behind the white clouds.” “I decided, or was told, to come back - it was not my time.” “I was across the room by the door, looking at her.” “Why were you crying?”
